name: 04021 · Cumberland, ME
findings: ZIP 04021 (Cumberland) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04021 (Cumberland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
